note:
The household of Julius Meyer, commission merchant, born in Germany, at Lindo House, South Road, on the 1891 return, transcribed by A. Hagues. None of the eleven was in the record. The record has no house called Lindo House, and the return gives no number, so the household is added unfiled under the address the return gives.

Wright's Directory of Nottingham prints 'Julius Meyrick, of M. Schilling & Co.' on South Road in 1894-95 and 1898-99, without a number or house name, between Gardenhurst and Parkhurst. That is very likely the same man under an anglicised name, and is noted rather than joined. Of South Road's houses in the record, only number 3 (the McCraiths, Ellenborough House) holds an 1891 census. Ages are as the enumerator wrote them, so a birth year worked back from one may be a year out either way.
source: 1891 census, Lindo House, South Road, transcribed by A. Hagues. Directory evidence: Wright's Directory of Nottingham 1894-95, page 136 (Leicester Special Collections id 164642); 1898-99, page 146 (id 165322).
